title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 5: Eds & Meds 1
premise: The presenter builds early hospital, university, and government institutions in Franklin and argues their benevolence and universal promises conceal quarantine, restricted access, and class privilege; their landscaped beauty contrasts with his account of ineffective care.
coverage: Hospital construction, university grounds, the temporary capital, ABOLISH ICE, and a closing city tour set to classical music. Historical interpretations are the presenter's; brief transitions and exact camera paths remain uncertain.

panels.heading: Franklin title and city introduction
panels.description: Orange FRANKLIN lettering and bell emblem overlay a high aerial city view; A DONOTEAT SERIES appears beneath.
panels.camera: Cuts from a black title background to high aerial and closer oblique city views.
panels.action: The title remains over changing city views.

panels.heading: Money-back opening; assemble the hospital
panels.description: The editor begins with a short access road beneath a green/red EPISODE 5 / EDS & MEDS 1 banner, dated 1788 → 1799; later the rotunda and wings are assembled.
panels.camera: Overhead and closer oblique framings alternate, with a brief pullback to the wider city.
panels.action: The builder places the rotunda and assembles its long wings.
panels.visualGag: The mock no-techno policy set up here pays off when classical music accompanies the closing cinematics. The presenter also pretends to have listened to complaints about his last opening, says he does not care, and repeats abolish ICE; the next panel fills the screen with the demand.
panels.notes: The episode banner dates the build from 1788 to 1799.

panels.heading: ABOLISH ICE: the non-apology gets a visual punchline
panels.description: Large bold white ABOLISH ICE text overlays the hospital rotunda and construction lawn after the presenter dismisses complaints about his political opening.
panels.camera: The overlay holds over changing overhead hospital views and is gone by the frontal view of the hospital.
panels.action: The text overlays continuing hospital editing.
panels.visualGag: His faux apology becomes I don't care and also abolish ICE, then oversized lettering repeats the demand.
panels.notes: The slogan also recalls episode 4's opening ABOLISH ICE card.

panels.heading: Hospital frontage and access
panels.description: The rotunda and long pale wings form a symmetrical frontage behind a semicircular access road preview.
panels.camera: A frontal view of the hospital gives way to overhead road-editing views.
panels.action: A curved road is drawn across the hospital lawn.
panels.visualGag: The ABOLISH ICE lettering gives way to ordinary hospital construction.

panels.heading: Physical and mental illness wings
panels.description: Hospital wings flank the rotunda, with perpendicular end blocks and planted paths being added.
panels.camera: The view rotates around the hospital, alternating close wing views with higher overviews.
panels.action: Building pieces and paths are selected and repositioned.

panels.heading: Benevolence with catches
panels.description: An oblique view reveals the hospital clock tower and domed center, surrounded by still largely empty grounds.
panels.camera: Rapid reframing around the compound, followed by an overhead front-lawn view.
panels.action: Selections flash red and blue; the builder edits surfaces and paths.

panels.heading: Beautiful frontage, dangerous treatment
panels.description: Orange flowering shrubs outline triangular beds around a small fountain in front of the hospital.
panels.camera: Close front-lawn views pull back to show the whole institution.
panels.action: Trees, flowers, and a fountain populate the frontage while narration describes overcrowding and poor hygiene.

panels.heading: No germ theory, no anesthesia
panels.description: A close overhead view of the curved road shows a row of circular yellow placement guides beside a flower border.
panels.camera: Views move among the courtyard, wings, and road edge.
panels.action: Fence/prop placement guides and blue selection outlines move around the grounds.

panels.heading: Whiskey, wood, and speed
panels.description: The hospital rear lawn and path junction are seen from above with a soft circular terrain brush.
panels.camera: Camera shifts from wing edges to rear grounds, then tighter courtyard framing.
panels.action: Ground surfaces are painted and prepared for the formal garden.

panels.heading: Ineffective cures; formal garden geometry
panels.description: Rectangular and L-shaped raised beds are arranged over a fenced red-brick garden surface.
panels.camera: Close overhead framing moves across the garden bed layout.
panels.action: The builder adds and aligns individual planter shapes.

panels.heading: Temporary statue preview during garden building
panels.description: Two turquoise equestrian statues on pale plinths appear beside one another on the garden brickwork.
panels.camera: Close overhead and oblique framing, then a pullback.
panels.action: A blue statue preview moves around the garden. One statue lingers for a moment before both large figures disappear.
panels.notes: The rider is unidentified, and no deliberate statue joke is apparent.

panels.heading: Pleasant surroundings versus beatings
panels.description: White benches flank formal planting beds, with a round central bed and L-shaped beds against the red paving.
panels.camera: Close overhead editor views pan/reframe across separate garden beds.
panels.action: Benches, beds, and trees are placed as the narrator undercuts pleasant-surroundings therapy with beatings.
panels.notes: The beatings joke is spoken over gardening; no beating is shown.

panels.heading: Quarantine behind the landscaping
panels.description: An orange flower border curves around the lawn below the rear of the rotunda.
panels.camera: The view travels from the small garden to the back of the hospital, then pulls up to the whole compound.
panels.action: Shrubs and edging are added around the rear lawn.

panels.heading: Self-preservation rather than charity
panels.description: The finished-looking rear flower border and paths sit beneath the rotunda; trees screen the perimeter.
panels.camera: Close and wider overhead framings alternate before the view moves toward nearby blocks.
panels.action: Trees and fence/edge props continue to be placed.

panels.heading: Courts miss the wealthy; university begins
panels.description: Two pale institutional buildings stand on opposite sides of a straight internal street in an otherwise empty gridded block.
panels.camera: Wide overhead campus views, with two brief tilts up toward the sky.
panels.action: Roads and university building assets are laid out.

panels.heading: A university, not mass credentialing
panels.description: A central columned red-brick hall fronts a road, with additional large campus buildings nearby.
panels.camera: A closer oblique view widens to campus overheads.
panels.action: Large institutional assets are selected and supplemented with smaller blocks.

panels.heading: Medicine, law, theology, philosophy
panels.description: The expanded campus has several large pale buildings, smaller brick blocks, and branching red-brick paths.
panels.camera: Overhead framing shifts and rotates across the central quad.
panels.action: Red paving is extended along pedestrian routes.

panels.heading: Philosophy and the anti-STEM aside
panels.description: A steep-roofed, turreted campus building is selected in blue.
panels.camera: A brief upward sky view is followed by building closeups and overhead campus views.
panels.action: The builder adjusts a building footprint and path connections.

panels.heading: Apprenticeships and optional primary school
panels.description: A near-overhead view shows two pale campus buildings at the edge of a rutted dirt street, with red-brick paths and trees behind.
panels.camera: The editor tracks/reframes along the campus street edge, including tight building-front and wider views.
panels.action: Paths, fences, and landscaping are adjusted.

panels.heading: Oversized campus and debt-bubble future
panels.description: The completed campus is seen from a lower oblique angle, with large white buildings and planted grounds beside the dirt street.
panels.camera: The view pulls back from the campus, tips briefly toward the sky, then turns to neighboring row-house construction.
panels.action: The builder shifts to infilling nearby blocks and laying roads.

panels.heading: State House and temporary capital
panels.description: A red-brick State House with a clock/cupola tower is flanked by low brick blocks.
panels.camera: A close oblique view of the tower gives way to a higher overview of the site.
panels.action: Government building pieces are selected and placed.

panels.heading: Constitutional progress with unequal rights
panels.description: A wider block contains government structures and long rows of dark-roofed buildings around open grounds.
panels.camera: The editor repeatedly pulls back, rotates, and moves closer to different block edges.
panels.action: Buildings, trees, and infill assets are added.

panels.heading: Brick sidewalks for dignitaries
panels.description: A straight strip of red paving is placed alongside the government buildings, visible with a blue guide and spacing controls.
panels.camera: Close overhead framing follows the street frontage.
panels.action: Red-brick surface props form a sidewalk strip.

panels.heading: Burnout and recording ahead
panels.description: A newly placed pale building sits beside a tree-filled courtyard block, among red-brick paths and long rows of housing.
panels.camera: View moves across neighboring blocks, alternately close overhead and wider city framing.
panels.action: Additional buildings and paving are placed while the presenter explains his break and upload queue.

panels.heading: Railroad promise and goodbye
panels.description: An overhead residential block is being landscaped with a blue tree-placement cursor and editor windows still open.
panels.camera: The overhead editing view repositions across small houses, then passes through black.
panels.action: Trees are selected/placed; no railroad is shown yet.

panels.heading: Cinematic: government frontage
panels.description: The interface disappears; the State House tower anchors a low oblique aerial of the red-brick government precinct and nearby rows.
panels.camera: Changing aerial angles suggest an orbit or sideways move around the precinct; the exact path is uncertain.
panels.action: The completed city appears without construction controls.
panels.visualGag: Classical orchestral music accompanies the city aerials, fulfilling the opening promise of no techno in the cinematics.
panels.notes: The video credits Beethoven's Symphony No. 5, III. Allegro, performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra.

sound.text: Music rises after a near-silent transition. The credited Beethoven Symphony No. 5, III. Allegro, performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra, fulfills the opening no-techno promise.

panels.heading: Cinematic: hospital gardens
panels.description: Hospital rotunda, long wings, clock towers, and orange-bordered triangular lawns fill the oblique aerial view.
panels.camera: After a cut from the government shot, the camera rotates and travels around the hospital.
panels.action: Finished hospital grounds are presented without the editor interface.

panels.heading: Cinematic: university and surrounding blocks
panels.description: Aerial view of pale campus buildings and the surrounding small houses, trees, and dirt streets.
panels.camera: Cut to a different campus/neighborhood framing, followed by changing oblique aerial viewpoints.
panels.action: No visible construction action.

panels.heading: Cinematic: row houses beside the university
panels.description: Long red-brick residential rows and central trees occupy the block adjacent to the pale university buildings.
panels.camera: Cut to a closer oblique neighborhood view, then toward the campus.
panels.action: Finished street blocks and planted courtyards appear.

panels.heading: Cinematic: city-scale payoff
panels.description: A very high overhead view shows the hospital and university as pieces of the larger street grid.
panels.camera: A cut to a lower neighborhood aerial; the view rises and pulls back, changes angle, then cuts to black.
panels.action: The visual ending integrates institutions with residential blocks and open fields.

panels.heading: Patron credits
panels.description: White text headed My Patreons lists supporters on a black background.
panels.camera: Static credit card.
panels.action: Supporter names remain on black.

panels.heading: DONOTEAT coin end mark
panels.description: A grey token marked GOOD FOR / DNE / ONE FARE is crossed by a diagonal translucent red band on black.
panels.camera: Static logo.
panels.action: The channel token closes the video.
